name: Kimi ga Daichi ni Kaeru made
original_name: きみが大地に還るまで
source:
The earth is made of stone
The people are made of stone

We are born of stone
Fated to assume its form when we die

To live is to consume and encroach
The very earth that gave birth to us

Your next meal
Your next step

The stars in the sky
The bottom of the ocean

All of it

Could have once been a living being

Join Floy, a newly born stone child
and Kite, a famous inhabitant of the planet
as they embark on an adventure
to see the world for themselves

Meeting various characters along the way,
what will Floy make of the world's principles?

[From [url=https://norihomu.wixsite.com/freetimetranslation/stone]Freetime Translations[/url]]
translation:
地球是由石头构成的
人民是石头做的

我们生于石头
当我们死后，注定会呈现出它的形状

活着就是消耗和侵占
孕育我们的地球

你的下一顿饭
你的下一步

天上的星星
海洋的底部

所有这一切

可能曾经是一个生物

加入弗洛伊，一个刚出生的石头孩子
还有风筝，这个星球上著名的居民
当他们踏上冒险之旅时
亲眼看看世界

一路上遇到各种各样的人物，
弗洛伊将如何看待世界原则？
